Subject: Re: Ready to kick off org activation

Samir — great, thanks. Confirmed availability the week of Feb 16 for a 60-minute kickoff. Proposed agenda:

- High-level objectives & success criteria (5m)
- Roles & owners (who needs admin vs engineer access) (10m)
- Project namespace, service-account patterns, and API key seeding (20m)
- KMS/HSM integration & key policies (10m)
- Timeline & MAP (Mutual Action Plan) — deliverables & dates (15m)

Quick answers up front:
- We can provision a non-prod workspace and seed two service accounts with scoped API keys by Feb 18 provided we have the Access Matrix and the KMS contact by Feb 12.
- We recommend the project namespace: fluxhealth-sandbox and fluxhealth-prod (for future rollouts).
- We prefer using a customer-managed KMS for production keys; for sandbox we can provide Redwood-managed ephemeral keys.

Neha — could you draft a short technical checklist for the kickoff (service account roles, required ports, SSO metadata, sample API policy) and attach it to the MAP? Monica — I'll leave scheduling and MAP distribution to you.

Samir / Priya — please confirm a good kickoff time next week and upload the Access Matrix to the Drive link in my signature.

Best,
Jonas
Senior Onboarding Manager
Redwood Inference
From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@fluxhealth.com>, Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@fluxhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 14:37:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Ready to kick off org activation — tech checklist

Adding a concise checklist so the kickoff can be purely execution-oriented:

1) Namespaces & projects
   - Suggested: fluxhealth-sandbox (non-prod), fluxhealth-prod (reserved)
   - Confirm desired region (us-west-2 recommended)

2) Service accounts / API keys
   - Seed two service accounts: ingestion-sa, inference-sa
   - Keys: issue scoped API keys with limited token TTL for sandbox; production keys must be backed by customer's KMS (bring-your-own-key)
   - Provide KMS key ARN and admin contact if production KMS is required

3) Roles & invites
   - Admin (1): Priya Sharma
   - Engineers (4): list names (please provide emails) — suggest role: Developer (no billing privileges)
   - Product (2): PM role (Viewer + Experiment controls)

4) Networking and egress
   - IP allowlist or VPC peering? If VPC, provide VPC CIDRs and route table contact

5) Quotas & rate limits
   - Sandbox limits: 100 qps burst with 10 rps sustained per service account by default

6) Audit, retention & logs
   - Default logs retained 30 days; request for extended retention must be approved (prod)

7) Deliverables ahead of provisioning (by Feb 12)
   - Completed Access Matrix (attached)
   - KMS contact / ARN (if prod keys required)
   - SAML metadata (if SSO)

Attachments: initial checklist, example policy snippet

I will prepare the service-account seed file and a small script to create the two accounts during provisioning; attaching the seed keys file (service-account-seed.txt) to the MAP we circulate.

—Neha
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
